![banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_header.webp) [![Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/D1D8LKA5N) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/869218732650688543?color=f7941f&label=DISCORD&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com/invite/S5nffJbuvA) [![CurseForge projects](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-projects-f7941f?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/finndog_123/projects) [![Modrinth projects](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-projects-f7941f?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnDog_123) [![檢視結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/c110cc09347a4f9f9de6c974f2fa35d8.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/missing-villages/1.21.1/) ![概述](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_overview.webp) 此模組支援 Forge、Fabric、NeoForge 與 Quilt！亦可僅安裝於伺服器端。 Forge 支援已於 1.20.4 版本後終止。 ## 本模組與 TERRALITH 不相容！ ### 關於 Moogs Missing Villages 為叢林與沼澤生態域新增了原版風格的村莊。其設計宗旨是盡可能貼近我們認為 Mojang 若推出這些村莊時會創造的樣貌。 [![即時以 3D 方式瀏覽每個結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/f8fe835413394a76b10a678afefea30f.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/missing-villages/1.21.1/) [![MinecraftStorage](https://imgur.com/ApCtgr7.png)](https://minecraftstorage.com/mods/mmv-moogs-missing-villages) ![特色](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_features.webp) ![拼貼](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/1ed547f7829847cfafee9ae5919d26ea.png) ![展示](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_showcase.webp) ### 影片
### 模組包 查看所有模組包請點擊[此處](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=69806)。 ![banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_discord.webp) 最快獲得回覆的方式是加入我們的 [Discord 伺服器](https://discord.gg/S5nffJbuvA)。 [![BHsponser](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_promo.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/moogsmods?r=mrmmv)
